nonPoolDecisions: Páipéar I before 2012 is the composition and the reading (220); the listening test is a paper of its own (irish_ordinary_2010_aural.py).

Composition: each of the nine printed titles is one 60-mark card (Tasc 3, Ábhar 9, Cumas Gaeilge 48, as the scheme prices each of the two pieces); choose-two is a choice, not a route; no combination cards. The scheme prints no 48-mark table, so Cumas Gaeilge is judged on its printed aspects.

Reading: the scheme prints no answers, only each question’s asks restated and one 10-mark price; each question is one card with one 10-mark criterion claimed whole (0 or 10) and marked tariffOnly; no part is a practice card of its own, because the scheme prices only the whole question.
caveats: Páipéar I = 220: composition 120 (any two of A–D at 60: Tasc 3, Ábhar 9, Cumas Gaeilge 48) and reading 100 (A the weather and B Raidió Rí-Rá, five questions each at 10).

Reading (PDF 4): each question restated with one price and no answer. One 0–5 language deduction under each passage; after B the redundancy penalty (“[Gearrfar pionós i ngeall ar iomarcaíocht]”) and the Nóta on showing the marks; cards state them without applying them.
Composition (PDF 3–4): the examiner’s Nóta misprints “Tasc” as “Tásc”; kept as printed. No 48-mark table and no short-attempt columns.
review.choicePolicy: Choice is not a route: each printed composition title is one card carrying the printed choose-two instruction; no combination cards.
review.boundaries: 9 composition titles at 60 (answer any two; no combination cards); 10 whole reading questions (each one 10-mark price, not split between its parts; the scheme prints no answers).

cards.questionText:
Ní mór do na hiarrthóirí cúram a dhéanamh de chruinneas na teanga. Caillfear marcanna má bhítear faillitheach ann.

Freagair do rogha dhá cheann de A, B, C, D anseo.

A · GIOTA LEANÚNACH (60 marc)
Scríobh giota leanúnach (leathleathanach nó mar sin) ar cheann amháin de na hábhair seo:
(i) An áit is fearr liom in Éirinn.
taskRequirements: Freagair do rogha dhá cheann de A, B, C, D anseo.
Write in the form the question asks for.
Keep a clear, continuous link between the title and what you write.
Leathleathanach nó mar sin.

criteria.label: An Tasc
guidance: Freagair do rogha dhá cheann de A, B, C, D anseo. I gcás A, B, C, agus D (Dhá cheann le freagairt) Leathleathanach nó breis: Tasc = 3 marc Ábhar = 9 marc = 60 marc × 2 = 120 marc Cumas Gaeilge = 48 marc

criteria.label: An tÁbhar
guidance: [Gearrfar pionós ar iarrthóirí mura mbeidh na hiarrachtaí ceapadóireachta ad rem.]

criteria.label: An Cumas Gaeilge
guidance: [Cumas Gaeilge = (i) fairsinge agus saibhreas Stór Gaeilge an iarrthóra (= 40%) móide (ii) beachtas maidir le máistreacht cruinnúsáide ar na príomhghnéithe de cheart na Gaeilge (= 50%) agus litriú (= 10%).]

Nóta: Caithfidh an Scrúdaitheoir an marc a bhronntar as 3 (Tásc), an marc a bhronntar as 9 (Ábhar) agus an marc a bhronntar as 48 (Gaeilge) a thaispeáint go soiléir ag bun na n-iarrachtaí ceapadóireachta.

cards.markingGuideNote: Whole 60-mark composition: Tasc 3, Ábhar 9, Cumas Gaeilge 48. The 2010 scheme prints no 48-mark table: Cumas Gaeilge is judged on its printed aspects, (i) the range and richness of the candidate’s Irish (40%) and (ii) accuracy in the main features of correct Irish (50%) and spelling (10%), so the award can take any value from 0 to 48. Socruithe Réasúnta (scheme PDF 11): for candidates granted reasonable accommodations, spelling and certain grammar features are not counted; the scheme prints no bands for it.

Ní mór do na hiarrthóirí cúram a dhéanamh de chruinneas na teanga. Caillfear marcanna má bhítear faillitheach ann.

Freagair do rogha dhá cheann de A, B, C, D anseo.

D · COMHRÁ (60 marc)
(i) Ba mhaith le do rang damhsa mór a chur ar siúl i halla na scoile ag deireadh na bliana.
Níl an príomhoide róchinnte faoin smaoineamh. Scríobh an comhrá (leathleathanach nó mar sin) a bheadh idir an bheirt agaibh faoin ábhar sin.
taskRequirements: Freagair do rogha dhá cheann de A, B, C, D anseo.
Write in the form the question asks for.
Keep a clear, continuous link between the title and what you write.
Leathleathanach nó mar sin.

criteria.label: An Tasc
guidance: Freagair do rogha dhá cheann de A, B, C, D anseo. I gcás A, B, C, agus D (Dhá cheann le freagairt) Leathleathanach nó breis: Tasc = 3 marc Ábhar = 9 marc = 60 marc × 2 = 120 marc Cumas Gaeilge = 48 marc

criteria.label: An tÁbhar
guidance: [Gearrfar pionós ar iarrthóirí mura mbeidh na hiarrachtaí ceapadóireachta ad rem.]

criteria.label: An Cumas Gaeilge
guidance: [Cumas Gaeilge = (i) fairsinge agus saibhreas Stór Gaeilge an iarrthóra (= 40%) móide (ii) beachtas maidir le máistreacht cruinnúsáide ar na príomhghnéithe de cheart na Gaeilge (= 50%) agus litriú (= 10%).]

Nóta: Caithfidh an Scrúdaitheoir an marc a bhronntar as 3 (Tásc), an marc a bhronntar as 9 (Ábhar) agus an marc a bhronntar as 48 (Gaeilge) a thaispeáint go soiléir ag bun na n-iarrachtaí ceapadóireachta.

cards.markingGuideNote: Whole 60-mark composition: Tasc 3, Ábhar 9, Cumas Gaeilge 48. The 2010 scheme prints no 48-mark table: Cumas Gaeilge is judged on its printed aspects, (i) the range and richness of the candidate’s Irish (40%) and (ii) accuracy in the main features of correct Irish (50%) and spelling (10%), so the award can take any value from 0 to 48. Socruithe Réasúnta (scheme PDF 11): for candidates granted reasonable accommodations, spelling and certain grammar features are not counted; the scheme prints no bands for it.
